instruments.name: THRONE//VOLT
instruments.description: Analog-style polysynth lead: a master saw, two drifting partner saws split left/right, a hard-synced scream oscillator and a sub square, through a hot mixer, a resonant 4-pole ladder with audio-rate growl, a throat colour and tube heat. Portamento, accents that sag the supply, held notes that bloom, releases that close the filter. Simulated at 2x and band-limited; deterministic.

articulations.normal: velocity-shaped attack (harder = faster and brighter), gate 97 %
articulations.accent: hard attack: the filter spikes, the supply sags a few cents and recovers
articulations.legato: no new attack: the voice glides from the previous pitch (slide in beats, else setup glide) and the filter re-blooms a little
articulations.swell: slow brass-like swell of level and filter (about half a second)
articulations.scoop: starts below and rises into the pitch (param scoop, semitones, default 1.5)
articulations.fall: the pitch falls away at the end of the note, accelerating like a moan (param fall, semitones, default 3)

controls.name: cutoff
controls.description: ladder cutoff in Hz at C4 (key-tracked from there)

controls.name: res
controls.description: ladder resonance (about 4 self-oscillates)

controls.name: env
controls.description: filter envelope depth in octaves (scaled by velocity)

controls.name: drive
controls.description: mixer and ladder input drive: thickness and grit before the filter

controls.name: heat
controls.description: asymmetric tube saturation after the VCA: even harmonics, density

controls.name: sync
controls.description: level and sweep of the hard-synced oscillator: the vocal scream

controls.name: detune
controls.description: partner oscillators, cents either side of the master

controls.name: sub
controls.description: square an octave below

controls.name: growl
controls.description: audio-rate filter FM from the sub: a snarl inside the tone

controls.name: vib
controls.description: vibrato depth in cents (arrives late in a held note)

controls.name: bloom
controls.description: held notes open up over about two seconds

controls.name: width
controls.description: partner oscillators split left/right (0 = mono)

controls.name: air
controls.description: breath of noise in the attack

controls.name: vowel
controls.description: two soft throat peaks (an open "aw") mixed after the filter

setup.description: random seed (drift, slop, noise)

setup.description: default portamento time in seconds for legato notes without a slide

setup.name: attack
setup.description: base attack time in seconds (velocity shortens it)

setup.name: release
setup.description: release time in seconds (the filter closes with it)

setup.name: vibRate
setup.description: vibrato rate in Hz

setup.name: drift

setup.description: how far the cutoff follows the keyboard

params.scoop: semitones to rise from on a fresh attack

params.cents: fine tuning of this note in cents (e.g. just-intoned chord tones)

instruments.name: CATHEDRAL//ENGINE Great
instruments.description: Unenclosed main division: principal chorus 8-4-2 2/3-2, Mixture IV, Bourdon 16' and Trumpet 8'. Pipe-by-pipe synthesis: per-harmonic speech, chiff and mouth noise, voicing and tuning scatter, a shared wind system that sags under big chords, C/C# chest layout, and the Nave space (high-passed tail). The macro is a crescendo pedal: stops enter in order.

articulations.soft: slow key: gentler, slower speech, little chiff
articulations.marcato: fast key: crisp speech, strong chiff and reed blat

controls.name: fifteenth

controls.name: trumpet8

instruments.name: HEAVEN//MASS Bass
instruments.description: Basses (C2-E4): the longest tract and a clustered ring, fundamentals lifted and the low mids carved; optional octavists an octave below for depth without mud. An ensemble of individually different singers (tuning, drift, vibrato, timing, tract, breath, seat) on an additive source-filter voice with this section's own formants; singers join as the ensemble grows; breath, air and the Nave.

articulations.sung: fresh onset: a small scoop and the singer settles into tune
articulations.legato: glides from the previous note (slide in beats, else about 75 ms)
articulations.hum: closed "mm" unless a vowel is given
articulations.fall: sighing fall at the end (param fall, semitones, default 1)

controls.name: ensemble
controls.description: how many of the section's singers sing (singers join one by one)

controls.name: breath
controls.description: aspiration in the tone and the depth of the inhales before phrases

controls.name: air
controls.description: unvoiced sheen above 5 kHz that follows the singers: height without harshness

controls.name: effort
controls.description: vocal effort: brighter, richer source as it rises

controls.name: vib
controls.description: vibrato depth scale (each singer keeps their own rate and depth)

controls.name: width
controls.description: how far the singers spread around the section's seat

controls.name: room
controls.description: send to the Nave

controls.name: octavist
controls.description: octavists an octave under the basses (bass section only)

controls.name: tract
controls.description: throat size: -1 giant (formants down 15 %) .. 1 small (up 15 %)

setup.name: seed
setup.description: random seed (who the singers are)

setup.name: singers
setup.description: singers in the section (default 6)

setup.name: octavists
setup.description: octavists under the basses (default 2; bass section only)

setup.name: tuning
setup.description: spread of the singers' tuning in cents (default 5)

setup.name: timing
setup.description: spread of the singers' onsets in ms (default 18)

setup.name: depth
setup.description: distance in the Nave: pre-delay, size and decay grow with it (default 0.5)

setup.name: lowCut
setup.description: high-pass on the room tail in Hz (default 140)

setup.name: center
setup.description: override the section's seat in the stereo field

setup.name: centre
setup.description: section tuning centred on the written pitch (1, default) or free (0: every singer's own offset)

setup.name: output
setup.description: "mix" (default: voices plus the Nave), "dry" or "wet"

params.cents: fine tuning of this note in cents (just-intoned chord tones)
